cases.question: What is the refund policy for annual plans?

documents.title: Refund Policy
documents.text: Annual plan subscribers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are prorated based on unused months. Monthly plans are non-refundable.

documents.title: Office Locations
documents.text: Our headquarters is located in Austin, Texas, with additional offices in Berlin and Singapore.

cases.reference_answer: Annual plan subscribers can get a full refund within 30 days of purchase; after that refunds are prorated.
